cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Camera-guided stove controller. Uses only rcb_client RGB-D and proprioception.
The interactive commands and every submitted action are retained in output/.
"""
import sys,json,time,os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras'])
obs=None; seq=0; samples=[]
def save(o,label):
 global obs,seq
 obs=o; seq+=1
 dest=OUT/f'{seq:03d}_{label}';o.save(dest)
 # lossless images for visual measurement
 for c,a in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(dest/f'{c}.png')
 panel=Image.new('RGB',(640,520));d=ImageDraw.Draw(panel)
 for i,(c,a) in enumerate(o.last.items()):
  x=i%2*320;y=i//2*260;panel.paste(Image.fromarray(a),(x,y));d.text((x,y+240),c,fill='white')
 panel.save(OUT/'latest.jpg')
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);
 if 'robot0_eye_in_hand' in o.meta['cameras']:
  samples.append((p[4:11].copy(),np.array(o.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl']),p[26:29].copy()))
  np.savez(OUT/'samples.npz',q=[s[0] for s in samples],eye=[s[1] for s in samples],eef=[s[2] for s in samples])
 print('saved',dest,'time_left',o.meta.get('time_left_s'),'eef',p[26:29].round(5),'q',p[4:11].round(5),flush=True)
 return o
def look(label='look'):
 return save(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'),label)
def state():return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def move(q=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0.,seconds=1.,label='move',ramp=True,mode=-1):
 p=state(); a=p[29:42].copy();a[8:12]=0;a[12]=mode
 if q is not None:a[:7]=q
 if grip is not None:a[7]=grip
 if base is not None:a[8:11]=base
 a[11]=torso;n=max(1,round(seconds/.05));A=np.tile(a,(n,1))
 if ramp and q is not None:A[:,:7]=np.linspace(p[4:11],q,n)
 path=OUT/f'actions_{seq+1:03d}_{label}.npy';np.save(path,A)
 with open(OUT/'commands.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'actions':str(path),'time':time.time()})+'\n')
 return save(r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=cams,video='none',include_depth=True,note=label),label)
def point(cam,u,v):
 cc=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(cc['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cc['cam2world_gl']);d=obs.depth[cam];d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
 z=float(d[int(round(v)),int(round(u))]); pc=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1])*z
 return (T@np.r_[pc*[1,-1,-1],1])[:3]
def proj(cam,p):
 cc=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(cc['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cc['cam2world_gl']);pc=(np.linalg.inv(T)@np.r_[p,1])[:3]*[1,-1,-1];return (K@pc)[:2]/pc[2]
def tx(x=0,y=0,z=0,rot=None):
 T=np.eye(4);T[:3,3]=[x,y,z]
 if rot is not None:T[:3,:3]=R.from_rotvec(rot).as_matrix()
 return T
DH=[(0,0,.333),(0,-np.pi/2,0),(0,np.pi/2,.316),(.0825,np.pi/2,0),(-.0825,-np.pi/2,.384),(0,np.pi/2,0),(.088,np.pi/2,0)]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for a,alpha,d,qi in zip([x[0] for x in DH],[x[1] for x in DH],[x[2] for x in DH],q):T=T@tx(x=a,rot=[alpha,0,0])@tx(z=d,rot=[0,0,qi])
 return T
B=C=None; eeoffset=None

def calibrate():
 global B,C,eeoffset
 def unpack(x):return tx(*x[:3],rot=x[3:6]),tx(*x[6:9],rot=x[9:12])
 def residual(x):
  b,c=unpack(x);err=[]
  for q,eye,ee in samples:
   pred=b@fk(q)@c;err.extend((pred[:3,3]-eye[:3,3])*3);err.extend(R.from_matrix(pred[:3,:3]@eye[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec())
  return err
 x=np.zeros(12);x[3:6]=[0,0,np.pi];x[6:9]=[0,0,.1]
 b,c=unpack(x);x[:3]=samples[0][1][:3,3]-(b@fk(samples[0][0])@c)[:3,3]
 fit=least_squares(residual,x,max_nfev=1000)
 B,C=unpack(fit.x)
 eeoffset=np.mean([(np.linalg.inv(B@fk(q))@np.r_[ee,1])[:3] for q,eye,ee in samples],axis=0)
 print('fit rms',np.sqrt(np.mean(np.array(residual(fit.x))**2)),'max',np.max(np.abs(residual(fit.x))),'B',B,'C',C,'eeoffset',eeoffset)
 np.savez(OUT/'kinematics.npz',B=B,C=C,eeoffset=eeoffset)
def pose(q):
 T=B@fk(q);return (T@np.r_[eeoffset,1])[:3],(T@C)[:3,:3]
def ik(p,rot=None,q0=None):
 q0=state()[4:11] if q0 is None else np.array(q0)
 if rot is None:rot=pose(q0)[1]
 def err(q):
  pp,rr=pose(q);return np.r_[(pp-p)*5,R.from_matrix(rr@rot.T).as_rotvec(),(q-q0)*.008]
 fit=least_squares(err,q0,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.06,-2.89,-.017,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=300)
 print('ik error',err(fit.x)[:6].round(5), 'q',fit.x.round(4))
 return fit.x
def goto(p,rot=None,seconds=2,label='goto',grip=None):return move(ik(np.array(p),rot),seconds=seconds,label=label,grip=grip)
if __name__=='__main__':look('connected')
PY
